item.title: KnowYou v1.2.7 (381)
item.description:
KnowYou 1.2.7 makes diary sharing easier and safer.
What's new: - Added Share Redacted for full diary entries and selected diary excerpts. - Share images are generated locally with a preview, download link, and QR code. - Redacted sharing is selected by default, with visible masking for sensitive details. - Copy Image now confirms when the image is ready to paste elsewhere.
Release details: - Version: 1.2.7 - Build: 381 - Released: 2026-06-15
